## [1.1.0](https://github.com/codeghost-glitch/codeghost-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-05)

### ✨ New Features

* **SongHub Android:** remove the serial activation key requirement ([fa8ec70](https://github.com/codeghost-glitch/codeghost-patches/commit/fa8ec70cfb95d4d0fa53466939ab8a0f908b742f))
* **SongHub Android:** allow custom packs ([0ebcc2f](https://github.com/codeghost-glitch/codeghost-patches/commit/0ebcc2f7fa8f256c23dc2cc511cf0c7d3df735b0))

patches.name: Unlock subscription
patches.description: Unlocks the subscription: no ads, unlimited PDF pages, unlimited songbooks and the hidden functions.

patches.name: Allow custom packs
patches.description: Loads your own .shubidx/.shubblob packs: skips the official-release hash check and plays songs that are not in the app's encrypted format.

patches.name: Unlock activation
patches.description: Removes the serial activation key requirement.

patches.name: Unlock remove-ads subscription
patches.description: Removes all ads: banners, native ads and interstitials.
